The mandate gate fails CI on any open STOP-SHIP/BLOCKER-1/BLOCKER-2 finding NOT in this list, and on any entry here that is no longer an open blocker. Adding an entry is an operator decision record; every acceptance must carry the compensating control + tripwire in audit/06-residual-risk-register.md.

production_note: Operator runs production under the compensating controls of audit/06; this is a recorded acceptance, not a clearance. Closing B-06 (rotation), A-01/B-35 (branch protection) and A-02 (mutation measurement) is the ratification path.

recorded_deviations.founding_record_schema_subset: The 119 founding finding records predate the §5 machine schema and carry a subset of its fields (no probe/clone_sweep/structural_fix/gate_decision/attestation per record; those live aggregated in audit/01-05). Retrofitting them would fabricate discovery-time detail. New/updated records must meet the enforced subset: evidence, na_justification on N/A, structured standing_control on PASS.
recorded_deviations.part2_text_absent: Track C verdicts exist (founding engagement) but the Part 2 normative text is not in-repo; recorded in mandate/manifest.json.
recorded_deviations.ratification_pending_operator: constitution_state stays IN_FORCE_PROVISIONAL until B-06 rotation, branch protection and A-02 mutation measurement land (the §11/Phase-7 ratification ordering is deliberately deferred to those operator actions).
recorded_deviations.no_autonomous_maintainer_fleet: §9.6's standing Maintainer/Runner fleet is infeasible for a solo-operator self-hosted monitor; the Runner role is GitHub Actions (weekly heartbeat), the Maintainer role is the operator-invoked agent session bound by CLAUDE.md + constitution.
recorded_deviations.catch_rate_binary: The S12 calibration is binary (all classes must catch) rather than a quantitative ratcheted SLI; the quantitative slot is registered open in audit/ratchet-baselines.json.
recorded_deviations.progressive_rollout_inapplicable: Single-instance self-hosted service: no traffic fractions exist; deploy.sh health-check + auto-rollback is the maximal substitute (fired live 2026-07-15).
